name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-06-06, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 5 moving objects.
